claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: GW-1929 is a PPARγ agonist that at 2.5 µM is expected to be largely inactive as a cytotoxic agent, since its only reported non-receptor activity (L-type calcium channel inhibition) requires ~5 µM and PPARγ agonism itself does not kill cancer cells.
